tasks.label: Build All (misc_dll.dll & run.exe)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cl.exe /LD /EHsc /O2 /Fe:"${workspaceFolder}\tools\misc_dll.dll" "${workspaceFolder}\tools\misc_dll.cpp" && cl.exe /EHsc /O2 /Fe:"${workspaceFolder}\tools\run.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\tools\run.cpp" && del "${workspaceFolder}\*.obj" "${workspaceFolder}\tools\*.obj" "${workspaceFolder}\tools\*.exp" "${workspaceFolder}\tools\*.lib" 2>nul
